question: I would like to know what the people of Lugunica think of the knights!
answer: Reinhard is by far the most popular and well-known of all the people. Some people say, “Even if I don’t know the king’s name, I know Reinhard.” However, the further away someone is from Reinhard, the more they praise him – but someone closer to him, the more they start to think, “He’s amazing, but unapproachable.”　After joining the Felt party, people in the Astrea family’s territory think “Reinhard is a nice guy, although I used to feel he was distant.” Julius is called “The Finest of Knights” and he has that reputation, but while he’s well-known among the Imperial Knights, he is not exactly popular within the citizens. Ferris is supposed to make house calls to the royal capital and surrounding nobles and rush to the scene with a group of doctors-like people when there is an epidemic, so he is popular with the citizens. Subaru is someone people don’t know much about. Since the information about his blunder at the castle (in Chapter 3) was limited to that time and was not known to the citizens, he is “someone who is close to the half-witch royal candidate and accomplishes all sorts of things.” In the Mathers territory, many people seem to say, “He’s very friendly and gives the impression of being approachable.” Al is considered quite distant. Priscilla is popular among the citizens, but since she is also a high profile person, Al standing beside her seems unapproachable. So, in order of popularity, Reinhard is the most popular => Ferris => Julius and Subaru are close => Al.
